# Worker Agents Tests Memory

## Purpose & Entry Points
- Unit tests for worker agent subsystem components (error handling, response processing, broadcasting, cleanup)
- Tests run via `bun test tests/worker/agents/`

## Patterns
- **Direct imports**: Import from specific source files to avoid `worker-service.js` import chain issues
- **Pre-import mocking**: Use `mock.module()` BEFORE importing the module under test
- **Helper factories**: Each test file defines `createMockSession()` and `createMockWorker()` helpers
- **Describe-based organization**: Tests grouped by method/behavior, then by scenario

## Key Test Files
- `fallback-error-handler.test.ts` - Tests `shouldFallbackToClaude()` and `isAbortError()` for error pattern matching
- `response-processor.test.ts` - Tests XML observation parsing, atomic DB transactions, SSE broadcasting
- `observation-broadcaster.test.ts` - Tests `broadcastObservation()` and `broadcastSummary()` with SSE payloads
- `session-cleanup-helper.test.ts` - Tests `cleanupProcessedMessages()` timestamp reset and status broadcasting

## Dos & Don'ts
- DO import directly from `src/services/worker/agents/*.js` (not worker-service.js)
- DO mock logger, ModeManager, worker-utils before importing module under test
- DO use `mock.restore()` in `afterEach` when using `mock.module()`
- DON'T import from worker-service.js (causes cascading import chain failures)
